access_denied: The connecting person's project access or GitHub account link is no longer valid. Have the project owner or a lead reconnect their GitHub account and try again
forge_conflict: This project's code is hosted on the platform and can't be switched to a GitHub repository
github_error: Couldn't verify your GitHub repository access. Reconnect your GitHub account, make sure it can reach the install and repository, then try again
internal_error: Something went wrong on the platform and the connection didn't take effect. Try again, and send feedback if it keeps failing
invalid_state: The install link has expired or been used. Come back to this page and choose Connect GitHub repository again
missing_installation_id: GitHub didn't return an installation ID, so the install didn't take effect. Try again
no_accessible_repos: This install didn't grant any repositories. Select at least one on GitHub's install page
project_not_found: This project can't be found; it may have just been deleted
repository_selection_required: This install can reach several repositories. Save the target under GitHub repository URL on this page first, then connect
repository_write_required: Your GitHub account can't write to this repository. Have a project owner or lead with write access connect it
upstream_not_accessible: This install doesn't grant the project's upstream repository, or your GitHub account can't access it. Check the repository URL and the install, then try again
